name: human-decision-inbox
purpose: Central source of truth for pending human decisions, approvals, clarification answers, and interrupt/resume handoffs across repository work.

reader_guide.summary: Use this inbox when work is waiting for a human answer but other work can continue. Keep every pending decision visible, answerable, and resumable.
how_to_read: Read inbox_policy first to understand state transitions and interrupt rules.
Read decisions to find open human decisions and their answer formats.
Use blocked_work to see what is paused and unblocked_work to see what can continue.
When an answer arrives, follow resume_action and update status.
update_triggers: A new human decision, approval, preference, or clarification answer is needed.
A human answer arrives for an open decision.
A decision is superseded, cancelled, expired, or resumed.

reference_links.title: LangChain Human-in-the-Loop
used_for: pause execution for pending user decisions
resume with explicit approval or rejection

reference_links.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows with AG-UI
used_for: resume payloads keyed by interrupt ID

structure_rules.rule: Every pending human choice gets one stable decision record with a unique id.
structure_rules.reason: Scattered questions in chat are hard to answer later and cannot reliably resume work.

structure_rules.rule: Each open decision must include question, options when useful, answer_format, impact, blocked_work, unblocked_work, and resume_action.
structure_rules.reason: A person should be able to answer without reconstructing the whole conversation.

structure_rules.rule: Before interrupting current work to resume an answered decision, record the current task, touched paths, verification state, and next safe return point.
structure_rules.reason: Interrupt/resume should not lose work or create hidden context debt.

structure_rules.rule: Decision status changes must update decision_history with timestamp, actor, from_status, to_status, and reason.
structure_rules.reason: Human decisions are audit events and should be traceable.

field_guide.meaning: State machine, priority, notification, batching, and interrupt/resume rules.
Current human decision records. Empty means no pending human decision is blocking work.
open, answered, resuming, resumed, deferred, expired, cancelled, or superseded.
Exact action the agent should take after the answer arrives.
Audit trail of created, answered, interrupted, resumed, or closed decisions.

inbox_policy.batching_rule: Collect related open decisions into one inbox update when the answers can be handled together.
interrupt_now_when: the answer unblocks the user's current top-priority task
continuing other work would increase rework or risk
the user explicitly says to resume immediately
schedule_resume_when: current work is in the middle of an unsafe edit
the decision priority is normal or low and current work has a near-term safe stopping point
the answer only affects documentation or backlog cleanup
resume_protocol: checkpoint current work before switching context
load the decision record and related artifacts
execute resume_action only on affected work
mark decision status as resumed or deferred
return to the interrupted task if it is still relevant
